name: Admin Diagnostic — Adjuntar desde Documentos
description: From the Correos tab of the diagnostic edit page, admin clicks 'Adjuntar desde Documentos'. A modal opens listing: NDA final + draft (if NDA generated), the 3 static MD templates fetched from GET /api/diagnostic-templates/, and any uploaded diagnostic attachments. Admin selects and confirms. Selected refs appear as emerald badges in the composer. On send, POST body includes doc_refs. This flow covers only the selection UX.
